findings.reason: diff.patch deletes the `node.tag !== defaultScalarTag.tagName` return, leaving only the isKey/PLAIN guard. presenter.ts:415-417 then sets shouldPrintTag when the style is non-plain and the tag isn't the default, so quoted non-strings come out tagged. This goes against the contract at presenter.ts:99 ('Quotes all non-key strings') and the locked test's name at dump-options.test.mjs:93.
findings.claim: Removing the tag guard makes forceQuotes quote every plain non-key scalar (ints, floats, bools, null), not only strings, and those values then get explicit tags such as !!int '5'.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes `if (layout.node.tag !== layout.presenterOptions.schema.defaultScalarTag.tagName) return`, so the only remaining guard is `layout.isKey || layout.style !== SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN`. In presenter.ts:415-417, `shouldPrintTag` becomes true when `layout.style !== SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN && node.tag !== state.defaultScalarTagName`, so each quoted non-string scalar gets an explicit tag. The option is still documented as 'Quotes all non-key strings using {@link quoteStyle}' (presenter.ts:99), CHANGELOG.md:134 says it forces 'quoting non-key strings', and the locked test is named 'forceQuotes — quotes non-key strings using quoteStyle' (dump-options.test.mjs:93). The packet has no story that asks for non-string values to be quoted.

findings.reason: The diff touches only styler_defaults.ts. The forceQuotes assertions at dump-options.test.mjs:94-101 and dump-scalar-styles.test.mjs:107 use only strings, and the property test that mixes forceQuotes with numbers, booleans and null is it.skip (dump-fuzzy.test.mjs:36).
findings.claim: No test covers forceQuotes with non-string scalars, so the behaviour change is unpinned and the existing tests pass either way.
findings.evidence: diff.patch touches only src/ast/styler_defaults.ts. The only forceQuotes assertions use string values (`dump({ hello: 'world' }, { forceQuotes: true })`, dump-options.test.mjs:94-101, and a string at dump-scalar-styles.test.mjs:107). The property test that combines `forceQuotes: fc.boolean()` with numbers, booleans and null is disabled with `it.skip` (dump-fuzzy.test.mjs:36), so nothing exercises non-string scalars under forceQuotes.

findings.reason: presenter.ts:99 and CHANGELOG.md:134 both still say 'non-key strings', and the diff changes only the inline comment. The mismatch is real, but it comes from C1/X1: reverting the code fixes it, so the docs are not the thing to change.
findings.claim: The option doc and CHANGELOG still say forceQuotes applies to strings only, which no longer matches the code.
findings.evidence: presenter.ts:99 reads 'Quotes all non-key strings using {@link quoteStyle}.' CHANGELOG.md:134 reads 'force quoting non-key strings'. Only the inline comment at styler_defaults.ts:64 was changed, to 'forceQuotes applies only to plain values, not to mapping keys.'
